title: Zero-fuel docked watch: a scout already docked at Factory Belt Manufacturing Hub (Nebula) saves its order book and mission board every 5 minutes for 30 minutes
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-23 11:40 UTC (orders ENT-081, block ORACLE: read the newborns' home regions first, books and boards; docked scouts with no due census keep watch, rule F8). The BLUEPRINT's zero-fuel hub market watch for scouts: a stop with market_poll and watch_minutes (route_run.py saves the book and the board at each poll, burns no fuel). Only a scout already in this system takes it (requires.in_system: requires.docked_at reads a pilot field the fleet file does not carry, requests.log to Unity 2026-11-23), so a ship moves at most within the system to dock; one ship a station, since a second reads the same book. Standing work: it gives fresh book readings (bid and ask refill, table stats_refill) and boards to Trade and Logistics while no census is due, and is never judged on its pay (F22).
